title: Mere Human Power Shall Fast Decay
description: Mere Human Power Shall Fast Decay in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 405 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"They shall walk and not faint."”, where the book credits them to Campbell's Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Mere hu-man power shall fast de-cay, And youth-ful vig-or cease; But they who wait up-on the Lord In strength shall still in-crease.

lines: Mere human power shall fast decay,
But they who wait upon the Lord
They with unwearied feet shall tread
On eagles' wings they mount, they soar;
Their wings are faith and love;
Till, past the cloudy regions here,
